title: Wave A of S2b: a commit under a slow hook, a held task, a slow step named
description: S2b wave A (quality-gates-internal plans/2026-11-27-s2b-at-head.md section 3): S2b.1 closes F762, S2b.3 closes F700 (OD3 taken: held), S2b.4 closes F764(b). S2b.2 waits on its haiku probe.
desiredOutcome: A task commit under a slow pre-commit hook runs under the caller's time limit and leaves no index.lock when killed; a task can be held with a reason so neither the ready set nor the gate counts it; a red gate run names a step that took more than twice its last recorded time.

tasks.title: A task commit runs under the caller's time limit in its own process group
tasks.description: F762. git commit under a pre-commit hook runs under a time the caller carries (config or argument), in its own process group; on expiry the whole group is killed, an index.lock the killed process left is reported by name and the message says exactly what state the index is in. Dependants (all call run_git): close-phase.py, integrate-task.py, _invariants.py, drive-phase.py; tests/test_close_phase.py, tests/test_integrate_task.py. COMPATIBILITY: nothing (time is not promised). Fragment kind fixed.

add: tests/test__scoped_commit.py: a pre-commit hook sleeping 2 s under a caller limit of 5 s and a built-in 1 s lands the commit (today killed at the fixed limit); a hook over the limit leaves no .git/index.lock and the message does not call the index 'could NOT be put back'

outcome.technical: _scoped_commit.py: new COMMIT_SECONDS built-in, run_git_group (git in its own process group via _proc_group.group_kwargs, communicate(timeout), overrun -> _proc_group.stop_and_drain, SIGINT/SIGTERM armed and re-raised), commit_stopped (HEAD moved -> committed+refused like the moved-HEAD precedent, index untouched; else HEAD unmoved, index.lock named by path and not removed, index put back via restored()); stage_and_commit, commit_from_index and commit_with_rows take commit_timeout. commit-task-work.py: --commit-timeout SECONDS (zero or less is a usage error) passed through commit_work/commit_state. _proc_group.py unchanged (its stop_and_drain is reused). Tests: tests/test__scoped_commit.py new block sc-ct (sc-ct0 skip where no killpg, sc-ct1..sc-ct6), sc24's seam moved from run_git to run_git_group because the commit no longer goes through run_git; tests/test_commit_task_work.py block cm-block (lim1..lim3). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md sections for _scoped_commit, commit-task-work, _proc_group updated; changelog.d/P175.1.fixed.md. Gates: sweep test__scoped_commit 93 cases ok, sweep test_commit_task_work 262 cases ok, register-citations pass, ruff pass, changelog-check ok, plus test__deps/test__output_lints/test_close_phase/test_integrate_task/test__invariants/test__proc_group/test__config 7/7 files ok. Mutations in a scratch copy (outside the tree): caller limit ignored -> sc-ct1,3,5,6 red; kill git only -> sc-ct2,3,5 red; lock not reported -> sc-ct6 red; restore claim made unconditional -> sc17, sc-ct6 red. Dependants: close-phase.py, integrate-task.py, drive-phase.py, audit-task.py, _live_copy, audit-lookup: still correct - they call run_git/commit_work/commit_state with unchanged signatures (new kwargs default None) and run_git itself is unchanged; _invariants.py: still correct, it uses _commit_trail._git not run_git; tests/test_close_phase.py and tests/test_integrate_task.py pass unchanged; test__scoped_commit sc24 changed (seam moved) as stated. _proc_group.py dependants: unchanged file.
outcome.descriptive: A task commit under a slow pre-commit hook runs under the caller's limit in its own process group; on overrun the whole group is killed, no index.lock is left in the ordinary case, and a lock that is left is named with the exact state of HEAD and the index.
